bis_banking.note: cross-border claims of banks located in the first country on all sectors of the second; released about 4 months after the quarter
bis_banking.source: BIS locational banking statistics (cite the BIS as source)

gdelt.note: GDELT 1.0 events between the two, dated by publication; conflict = CAMEO quad classes 3 and 4; threats = CAMEO root 13. Source: The GDELT Project.

cdis.note: direct investment of the first country in the second (reported by the host)

cpis.note: portfolio holdings of the first country in securities issued by the second (holder-reported)

imf_investment.source: International Monetary Fund, Portfolio (CPIS) and Direct (CDIS) Investment Positions by Counterpart Economy; EU = sum of the 27 members where all are published

portwatch.normal: average daily transits in the same calendar month of 2019, 2022 and 2023
portwatch.source: IMF PortWatch (IMF and University of Oxford, AIS data)

prices.source: World Bank Commodity Price Data (the Pink Sheet), CC BY 4.0

students.note: internationally mobile tertiary students from the first country enrolled in the second; year = academic year ending then; published 14-26 months later
students.source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), CC BY-SA 4.0

tic.note: by country of the custodian; end of month; released about 6-7 weeks after the month
tic.source: US Treasury, TIC: foreign holdings of US Treasury securities (public domain)

tourism.note: visitors from the first country to the second; each destination's own definition
tourism.source: national tourism and statistics offices (see series.json)

unga.note: UNGA voting agreement (Lijphart index) and ideal point gap; Voeten, Harvard Dataverse (CC0)
